text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired P12345 -> inference-eu-high-latency (priority: P1). Link: https://pd.redwood/P12345
pagerbot: Auto-escalation scheduled in 60s if not acknowledged
maria.g: taking, joining bridge now
kevin: thanks. region? any known customer impact yet?
lucas_oncall: I'm on the bridge. dashboards show spike in eu-west-1. 95th token latency ~3s, 5xx rate up. tagging infra.
chris: I can grab autoscaler and node logs, standing by
maria.g: quick runbook: check model load errors, k8s evictions, cache miss rate, and consider failing to fallback pool. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/PG-001
sara: @chris can you check node disk and GPU health? last deploy touched cache settings
chris: running commands now:
```
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/realtime-eu --since=10m | grep -i error
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep realtime-eu
```
chris: one pod shows OOMKilled at 16:10, logs show NVML reset messages. collecting full logs
maria.g: seeing cache thrash on prefix/KV layer — warm restart looks like it caused higher miss rate. preparing partial traffic shift to fallback pool
pagerbot: PagerDuty P12345 acknowledged by maria.g
kevin: can we move a portion of traffic to eu-fallback (lower capacity but stable)? want to reduce tail latency for paced customers
maria.g: initiating 20% -> eu-fallback via routing console now
lucas_oncall: metrics update: 95th latency drops 3s -> 900ms after shift; customer error rate 8% -> 1.2%
incidentbot: customer-impact: partial_degraded. affected customers: acme-inc, beta-saas. severity tag added
sara: opening support tickets for affected customers and pinging account team @account-eng
maria.g: handing to chris for infra deep dive. I'll remain for status pings 15m. @chris please escalate to platform-sre if node replacement needed
chris: taking. running node health checks and nvml diagnostics now
chris: found kernel spam about NVML resets on node-gpu-07. cordoning and moving pods off that node
kevin: evicting pods from node-gpu-07 now
```
kubectl drain node-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
```
maria.g: once node is drained and pods stabilize on other nodes, we'll monitor for 10-30m and decide on closing PD
lucas_oncall: monitoring 10m window, alerting thresholds still degraded but trending down
chris: pods rescheduled to node-gpu-09 and node-gpu-10; no further NVML errors showing in node logs
kevin: LB health checks passing, traffic distribution ok
maria.g: 30m post-mitigation: latency stable, error rate ~0.9%. planning to resolve PD in 30m unless objections
sara: ack, will update customer comms draft and notify account team
maria.g: thanks everyone. handing final follow-up (RCA & timeline) to ops-runbook and infra. I'll resolve the page after verification window
pagerbot: PagerDuty P12345 resolved by maria.g
chris: +1, I'll produce an infra RCA and attach kernel logs and nvml traces
lucas_oncall: FYI next oncall shift starts in ~2h. tagging next oncall @dylan to review RCA draft and any lingering runbook edits
maria.g: adding notes to incident board: https://incidents.redwood/board/12345 and will file short retro
